name: Zunami UZD permissionless monotonic rebase price latch
summary: UZD is an elastic rebasing token whose multiplier is PricableAsset._assetPriceCached. The deployed cacheAssetPrice() is public, unguarded, and monotonic: it reads assetPrice(), which is priceOracle.lpPrice() on the immutable Zunami core 0x2ffcc661011bec72e1a9524e12060983e74d14ce, and assigns it whenever it exceeds the stored value, so a single instantaneous reading permanently multiplies every UZD balance. Zunami.lpPrice() is totalHoldings over LP supply summed across strategies at spot, and the MIMCurveStakeDao strategy 0x9848edb097bee96459dff7609fb582b80a8f8efd values whatever SDT sits in it at the SushiSwap SDT/WETH pair price. In the anchor transaction the attacker bought 55,981.929088875410 SDT, transferred it to that strategy, whose totalHoldings() went from 0 to 12,645,055.766381 accounting units, pushed the SushiSwap pair further with a 10,000 WETH swap, and called UZD.cacheAssetPrice() directly. assetPriceCached rose from 912,563,583,136,402,763 to 3,165,200,435,397,696,033, a factor of 3.4685, rebasing the attacker's 4,873,316.59 purchased UZD into 16,902,957.87 sellable UZD; the SushiSwap swap was then unwound in the same transaction while the latch stayed at 3.1652 forever after, confirmed unchanged at block 17960000. The violated invariant is that the rebase multiplier must reflect durable vault backing. The boundary test finds no parameter value that restores it: priceOracle is an immutable constructor argument, and the only related setting, _assetPriceCacheDuration, gates _cacheAssetPriceByBlock() while cacheAssetPrice() stays publicly callable at any block.

loss.notes: The components are the attacker cluster's exact end-of-transaction proceeds, netted from every ERC-20 Transfer log of the anchor receipt for the helper contract 0xa21a2b59d80dc42d332f778cbb9ea127100e5d75 and the sender 0x5f4c21c9bb73c8b4a296cc256c0cde324db146df. Both flash facilities net to zero in that computation: the Balancer loan of 7,000,000 USDC and 10,011 WETH is repaid in full, and the Uniswap V3 USDC/USDT flash of 7,000,000 USDT is repaid with 7,000,710 USDT. The 11 WETH the attacker spent buying the donated SDT is likewise inside the net. The victims are the two Curve UZD pools 0x68934f60758243eafaf4d2cfed27bf8010bede3a and 0xfc636d819d1a98433402ec9dec633d864014f28c, which net out 1,534,228.182865474 3CRV and 641,017.5283662892 crvFRAX against the inflated UZD, plus every remaining UZD holder left with a token whose supply had been multiplied by 3.4685 without backing. The attacker's separate transaction 0x2aec4fdb2a09ad4269a410f2c770737626fb62c54e0fa8ac25e8582d4b690cca 41 blocks earlier ran the identical defect against the code-distinct zETH deployment 0xe47f1cd2a37c6fe69e3501ae45eca263c5a87b2b, which does not appear in this trace; that leg netted the attacker minus 62.840019684438608795 WETH and belongs to its own record, so no part of it is counted here. Nothing was recovered from this transaction.

ageReset.description: UZD is a non-proxy contract created by top-level CREATE; its 14,165-byte runtime is byte-identical at the creation block and immediately before the exploit, and its price oracle is an immutable constructor argument.

sources.note: Reviewed the anchor receipt and its 807-frame call trace, the verified UZD sources, the attacker's full transaction list, the UZD creation transaction, historical runtime and state reads, and the earlier zETH leg. Anchor: transaction 0x0788ba222970c7c68a738b0e08fb197e669e61f9b226ceec4cab9b85abe8cceb is status 1 at block 17908950 index 0, timestamp 1691966087. The trace contains the helper contract calling UZD 0xb40b6608b2743e691c9b54ddbdee7bf03cd79f1c with selector 0xd341ea79 (cacheAssetPrice()), which STATICCALLs Zunami 0x2ffcc661011bec72e1a9524e12060983e74d14ce lpPrice() and receives 0x2bed0d06aaca9a21. Reading state directly: lpPrice() was 913,693,284,061,799,977 at block 17908949, UZD.assetPriceCached() was 912,563,583,136,402,763 at 17908949, 3,165,200,435,397,696,033 at 17908950, and still 3,165,200,435,397,696,033 at 17960000, so the latch is permanent. MIMCurveStakeDao 0x9848edb097bee96459dff7609fb582b80a8f8efd reported totalHoldings() of 0 at block 17908949 and 12,645,055.766381 inside the exploit after receiving 55,981.929088875410 SDT (token 0x73968b9a57c6e53d41345fd57a6e6ae27d6cdb2f) that the attacker bought and donated, with the SushiSwap SDT/WETH pair 0x22def8cf4e481417cb014d9dc64975ba12e3a184 pushed by a 10,000 WETH swap that was unwound later in the same transaction. Target identity and code history: UZD was created by top-level CREATE from 0xe9b2b067ee106a6e518fb0552f3296d22b82b32b in transaction 0xd2505b8d272ffc8878e451b505d0e7a2f54be7070018984f9343f9c18fe82dd9 at block 16775408 index 92, timestamp 1678179743; the creator is unrelated to the attacker addresses. The contract is not a proxy - the verified UZD/ZunamiElasticRigidVault source has no delegatecall and no upgrade path, priceOracle is declared immutable - and its 14,165-byte runtime hashes to 0x88f7646f42dbab956a8b29083d47de1ef6b46602c550344328eec708becda085 at both block 16775408 and block 17908949, so deployment is the last code change and the age is 1691966087 - 1678179743 = 13,786,344 seconds. Loss: netting every ERC-20 Transfer of the receipt over the two attacker addresses leaves exactly 1152.938621116649685662 WETH and 1265.457045 USDT, with the Balancer 7,000,000 USDC plus 10,011 WETH loan and the Uniswap V3 7,000,000 USDT flash both fully repaid inside that net. Scope: the attacker's earlier transaction 0x2aec4fdb2a09ad4269a410f2c770737626fb62c54e0fa8ac25e8582d4b690cca at block 17908909 ran the same defect against zETH 0xe47f1cd2a37c6fe69e3501ae45eca263c5a87b2b, whose runtime hash 0x414d047bb31055b8e134b7f0de76ac07b816140492044b3552092fe703eef855 differs from UZD's and which is absent from this trace, so it is a separate deployment with an independent anchor, age and loss and is deliberately not represented here.

limitations: The record covers only the UZD leg of the campaign. The code-distinct zETH deployment was attacked in a separate transaction that does not execute UZD, so it needs its own incident record and is excluded from this loss.

notes: Zunami's own MIMCurveStakeDao strategy supplied the manipulable spot valuation, so it is a second defect-bearing role in the causal path. It is described in the classification rather than carried as a separate target because the invariant that fails, and the state that made the inflation permanent, both live in the UZD runtime.
